prompt: A seaside boardwalk at golden hour. A beautiful woman in a 1960s dress and a wide-brimmed hat made of old postcards — the tiny printed text visible: "BEST WISHES FROM THE COAST", "POST CARD — 1962", "SEA BREEZE & SAND" — a few postcards flapping in the wind. The boardwalk, the striped beach huts, the gulls, the golden light. Retro, joyful, 2:3 aspect ratio.

promptZh: 黄金时刻的海滨木栈道。一位美丽的女性身着 1960 年代连衣裙，戴着一顶由 旧明信片 制成的宽檐帽 —— 上面可见细小的印刷文字：“BEST WISHES FROM THE COAST”、“POST CARD — 1962”、“SEA BREEZE & SAND” —— 几张明信片在风中飘动。木栈道、条纹海滩小屋、海鸥以及金色的光影。复古、愉悦，2:3 宽高比。
